meta.title: Cyber egg pickup
meta.description: One page for free AI credit and point offers, API list prices, subscription tiers, the model routes your setup is wired to, and what those routes cost: vendor prices checked live, spend priced at peak/off-peak and cache-hit rates, forked sessions deduped, one-click official usage CSV import for reconciliation, a per-session token timeline per route, and per-image / per-token spend for cloud image and video generation. Everything stays on your machine and is never uploaded.
